ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 -3-  NC: 2024:KHC-K:7561  CRL.P No. 201103 of 2024 CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K NATARAJAN  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K NATARAJAN)

This petition is filed by the petitioners - accused No1 to 5 under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. seeking to allow the present petition and quash the FIR in Crime No.0044/2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498-A, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC, registered by the respondent No.1 - police, pending on the file of I Additional JMFC, at Bidar.
02. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners, the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent No.1 - State and the learned counsel for the respondent No.2.
03. The learned counsel for the respondent No.2 has also filed the statement of objections.
The same is taken on record.
The case of the prosecution is that on the complaint of respondent No.2 the police have registered the FIR on 21.05.2024 alleging that she has married to the petitioner No.1 on 11.05.2014.
At the time of marriage her father has given golden ornaments other utensils as per their customs.
Subsequently, she has stayed in the matrimonial home for some time.
They were look after her well.
Thereafter, they have started troubling her.
She was working in Karnataka Grameen Bank, at Hallikhed.
Later, her husband shifted to Bengaluru for job purpose.
Therefore, she left the job in Karnataka Grameen Bank.
She took the job in Cauvery Grameen Bank and working as a Clerk.
They have also got a female child who is aged about 02 years.
Subsequently, the accused Nos.1 and 2 used to quarrel and abused that she was not properly working and not hearing their words.
The other petitioners i.e., the sister-in-laws and their husbands, whenever they used to visit the house, they used to warned the complainant to hear the words of her husband and her mother-in-law.
They used to scold and go back.
In the NC: 2024:KHC-K:7561 meanwhile, she was worked at Bengaluru from the year 2016 to 2023.
Later she was shifted to Hallikhed village and stated in the house of her husband, wherein the accused No.2 also in the same house.
During the said stay, the accused Nos.1 and 2 abused her in filthy language, harassed her physically and mentally.
She has also says that she has also borrowed loan and provided a car to her husband, even he was not taking her in the said car, even though it is in her name.

In the meanwhile in the year September 2023, the accused Nos.1 Shashikant And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74804191/
3 and 2 said to be quarrel with her and thrown out her from the house.

sentences.text: Therefore, she went and stayed with her parents' house.

Subsequently, on 26.01.2024 in the evening her father brought her to her matrimonial home, where the accused Nos.1 and 2 not allowed inside, they abused them in filthy language and other accused persons were also abused in filthy language and not allowed them inside the house.
Therefore, the complaint came to be filed.
Thereafter, the FIR was registered, which is under challenge.
The learned counsel for the petitioners has contended that the complaint came to be filed only after serving the notice in the divorce case filed by the accused No.1.
The child was born through IVF method and she was blaming that child was not born to her and not belongs to her.
She is avoiding the child.
Therefore, there was a quarrel between them.
The same was narrated in the matrimonial case.
Even otherwise there is omnibus allegation against the accused Nos.2 to 5, but they have not at all harassed the complainant.
The married sisters, married about 22 to 25 years back and they are staying in different places, at Bengaluru and Pune.
They have been falsely implicated in this case.
Therefore, the conducting investigation is nothing but abuse of process of law.
Hence, prayed for allowing the petition.

06. Per contra, the learned counsel for the respondent No.2 seriously objected the petition contending that all the petitioners are jointly picked up quarrel and harassed the complainant physically and mentally.
Even in NC: 2024:KHC-K:7561 spite of giving golden ornaments, they are blaming that it is insufficient.
The accused Nos.1 and 2 were thrown the complainant from the house and they were not allowed the complainant to come inside the house.
There is prima- facie material placed on record for conducting the investigation for the cognizable offences.
Therefore, prayed for dismissal of the petition.
07. The learned High Court Government Pleader also supported the contention of the learned counsel for the respondent No.2 and submits that the matter is required for investigation.

Hence,
prayed for dismiss the petition.
08. Having heard the arguments and on perusal of the records, which reveals that of course the complaint came to be filed on 21.05.2024 after filing the matrimonial case by the accused No.1.

During the course of arguments, the learned counsel for the petitioners not pressed the petition of the accused No.1.
10.

However, on careful reading of the complaint, there is allegation against the accused Nos.1 and 2 together, where the complainant was stayed after transfer from the Bengaluru and stayed in the matrimonial home, where the accused No.2 was with the accused No.1.
Of course the accused No.3 the brother of the accused No.1 is not staying with them and he was working at Bengaluru.

The accused No.4 who is the sister of the accused No.1 and accused No.5 were married and residing in Shashikant And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74804191/
4 Pune and Bengaluru respectively.

sentences.text: Even on perusal of the complaint, there is no specific allegation or specific date mentioned by the complainant when they came and picked up quarrel and assaulted the complainant.

There is omnibus allegation that whenever they used to come to their mother's home, they used to warned the complainant that she should obey the order of her husband and mother-in- NC: 2024:KHC-K:7561 law.
Except this blaming or scolding, there is no any other allegation against the accused Nos.3 to 5 for giving any harassment on the complainant.

11. There is prima-facie material placed on record against the accused Nos.1 and 2 for taking cognizance to investigate the matter by the police, whereas the allegation against the accused Nos.3 to 5 are omnibus and there is no specific allegation.
Therefore, the criminal investigation against the accused Nos.1 and 2 shall be proceeded.

Therefore, I proceed to pass the following;
 ORDER  I.
The petition is allowed in part.
II. The petition filed by the petitioners No.1 and 2 - accused Nos.1 and 2 is hereby dismissed.
III. The petition filed by the petitioners No.3 to 5 - accused Nos.3 to 5 is hereby allowed.

The FIR against the petitioners No.3 to 5 - accused Nos.3 to 5 in Crime No.0044/2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498-A,
504 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC, registered by the respondent No.1 - police, pending on the file of I Additional JMFC, at Bidar, is hereby quashed.

In view of disposal of the main petition, the pending I.As. do not survive for consideration, hence,
they are also disposed of.

Sd/-
